mapper.sql: m.message_id, m.room_id, m.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image, m.msg_type, m.content, m.ref_id, m.start_time, m.end_time, m.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_message (room_id, user_id, msg_type, content, ref_id, start_time, end_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{refId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM room_message m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.message_id = #{messageId}
